node.question: Does the edited image visibly combine comic-book styling with a photographic appearance?
node.criteria: Pass if the overall edited image visibly has comic-book styling while retaining recognizable photographic subject matter. Fail if it does not show that combination. Unknown if the image or its visual treatment cannot be assessed.
